SCHEDULE: {"1":"Hana","2":"Ann","3":"Dev","4":"Ben","5":"Cara","6":"Finn","7":"Gus","8":"Elif","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 99

The schedule is forced. Ben is right after Dev, Cara is right after Ben, and Cara is two slots from Gus, so Gus is Dev+4. Finn is right before Gus, so Finn is Dev+3. Elif and Ivo come after Gus, so they take Dev+5 and Dev+6 at the latest. Hana and Ann both come before Dev, since Ann sits right after Hana and Ann must precede Dev's chain. That needs three slots before Dev, so Dev is slot 3. Every other position follows.

I checked all 19 constraints against this order and they hold. The shared note is wrong on both options. Dev in slot 4 would put Ben in slot 5, not Cara, and would break "Dev before Cara." Elif in slot 9 with Ivo in slot 8 violates "Elif before Ivo."
